title: D4-native BP-MWPM threshold bracket around p_X=0.35
question: Does finite-size flux failure for D4 BP posterior-LLR -> MWPM cross near p_X=0.35, or does the real D4 channel falsify that Lab-003-motivated conjecture?
scope: X-only D4 channel, p_Z=0, first-stage flux Boolean-union loss conditional on nonterminal histories. This intentionally does not claim the paper's full two-stage D4 logical threshold.
implementation: validated cached dense-Numba realization of the same public-record BP recurrence; generic Python BP outputs are retained only as frozen equivalence controls, not mixed into this allocation.

scan_design.stage_2_selection_rule: Select p_X values where adjacent-size BP conditional-risk estimates reverse sign or whose 90% difference interval includes zero, plus one neighboring grid point on each side. Add matched 1000-history increments only to selected cells.
inference_accounting: 40-vs-160 iteration matched sensitivity near the bracket (secondary)

comparators: O0 unit-weight MWPM (retained because its runtime is negligible relative to BP)
claim_boundary: Stage 1 is a bracket search, not a threshold fit. A claim near 0.35 requires a resolved multi-size crossing and iteration-budget stability on matched records.
